{#- Link previews and a page description, which the theme does not write. A link to these docs shared on LinkedIn, Slack or Teams builds its preview from Open Graph tags; without them it shows no image and no summary. Every page gets its own title, its own description (from _ext/page_description.py, else the package's one-line summary) and the social card, at the absolute addresses set in conf.py (html_baseurl, html_context). -#} {%- extends "!layout.html" %} {%- block extrahead %} {{ super() }} {%- set page_title = (title | striptags | e) if title else docstitle | e %} {%- if pagename != root_doc %}{% set page_title = page_title ~ " | process-improve" %}{% endif %} {%- set summary = page_description or social_description %} {%- if pageurl %} {%- endif %} {%- endblock %}
